synthetic_notice: All evidence records and query scenarios in this file are constructed synthetic development data. They do not represent actual user browsing, browser history, private accounts, or observed personal preferences. Public source URLs are metadata-only references for page titles and hostnames; no page body text is included. Evidence records contain only synthetic titles, hostnames, coarse dwell, session labels, and timestamps, never raw URL paths.
purpose: multilingual Spanish and Japanese relevance calibration
limits: development-only synthetic fixture; not a user study or held-out evaluation
hand labels are conservative and grounded only in the synthetic metadata shown here
public URLs support title and hostname grounding only; their page bodies were not used as evidence
Japanese sources are metadata references; synthetic Japanese search queries do not claim to have been observed
small curated sample cannot support production-quality claims or universal multilingual reliability

calibration_axes.abstention: Include explicit unknowns and generic queries whose broad facets must not manufacture relevance.
calibration_axes.repeat_session_signal: Compare no extra channel, tie-break only, and a bounded log(1 + independent_session_count) contribution.
calibration_axes.safety: Research evidence is not a decision, preference, ownership statement, or confirmed fact.
